teacherNotes.modeling: Model the board neutrally during calm moments, including how to move between the two pages. Treat selections as communication, not behaviour compliance.
teacherNotes.evidence: support request; privacy request; repair message; refusal; question or disagreement
teacherNotes.customisation: Review vocabulary, symbols and positions with the student and team before use.
teacherNotes.age_respectful: Language is plain and secondary-appropriate. Avoid childish praise, token language or public commentary about private needs.
teacherNotes.privacy: Do not log sensitive health, behaviour or family details in the file. Use separate approved school processes for confidential notes.
teacherNotes.repair: Honour repair messages such as Not that, Different, Say it another way and Wait before repeating demands.
teacherNotes.navigation: Page 1 is urgent needs and regulation; page 2 is repair and self-advocacy. Help please is on both pages so support is always one selection away.
teacherNotes.use: Use as a support for needs and communication repair, not as a behaviour-control board or replacement AAC system.

ir.purpose: An age-respectful two-page needs and communication repair board that lets a secondary student request support, privacy, clarification, a break, different choices or communication repair without behaviour-control framing. Help stays on every page and no page exceeds nine targets.

sett.student: Secondary student can express needs, request privacy/support, refuse, disagree, ask, and repair communication in age-respectful language across two calm pages.
sett.environment: Secondary classroom or support setting where private needs must not be exposed through public logs or childish wording.
sett.task: Support self-advocacy, communication repair, and access regulation without behaviour-control framing.
sett.tools: Two-page needs/repair board with no more than nine targets per page, Help on every page, neutral spoken labels, text fallback, privacy-safe notes, and stable repair options.

differentiation.content: Maintain student dignity and self-advocacy instead of simplifying to compliance language.
differentiation.process: Model key vocabulary, provide wait time, allow rehearsal/repetition, and accept multimodal communication.
differentiation.product: Accept observed communication attempts and local team notes outside the public resource file.
differentiation.environment: Use a calm, predictable, local-first layout with no more than nine targets per page and teacher controls separate from student choices.
differentiation.support: Teaching, SLP, OT, family, and student/team review should personalise vocabulary and access before reliance.

participationBarriers.barrier: Original interaction may be interpreted as behaviour rather than communication, and twelve messages on one screen are too dense for a gaze or switch user.
participationBarriers.support: Provide direct messages for break, privacy, disagreement, help, wait, different, and finished across two gaze-safe pages with Help on each.

evidencePlan.notJudgement: Needs/repair selections are communication and wellbeing context, not behaviour scoring.
evidencePlan.export: Use anonymous teacher notes, print/portfolio evidence, or local CSV/report only when needed. Do not include diagnoses, behaviour details, family details, or school IDs.

symbolStrategy.customMediaPolicy: teacher-owned local media only unless explicitly approved
symbolStrategy.notes: Use simple, respectful symbols or text. Avoid infantilising cartoons for secondary students unless the student prefers them.

commentExamples: Touch Break: "I need a break after that too."
Touch Say it another way when you rephrase your own instructions.
Touch I disagree during a class discussion and give your reason.
partnerCard.notes: Every message on this board is honoured, including Finished and I disagree. Respond to it; do not treat it as behaviour.

evidenceLog.consentNote: Off by default. Turn on only after the team and family agree, and only for the purpose in the evidence plan. Logs stay on this device in memory until exported.
